summary.en: 10Y Treasury Yield declined from 4.45% Thursday toward 4.35% on de-escalation. Yield compression supports duration assets. Curve steepening from 2s10s spread narrowing. Fed policy uncertainty persists; Powell June meeting critical. Rate-sensitive assets rally. Watch for USD flows and inflation expectation shifts.
summary.zh: 10Y 美债收益率从周四 4.45% 下降至约 4.35% 因去升级。收益率压缩支持久期资产。曲线从 2s10s 收窄陡峭化。Fed 政策不确定性犹存；鲍威尔 6 月会议关键。利率敏感资产 rallies。关注美元资金流向和通胀预期转变。

title.en: De-escalation Drives 10Y Treasury Yield Down to ~4.35%
title.zh: 降级推动 10Y 美债收益率降至约 4.35%

impact.en: 10-year Treasury yield declined from 4.45% Thursday toward 4.35% on de-escalation sentiment. Yield compression supports duration assets including growth stocks and bond ETFs. Curve steepening from 2s10s spread narrowing supports longer-duration positions. Fed policy uncertainty persists; Powell June meeting critical for rate path clarity.
impact.zh: 10 年期美债收益率从周四 4.45% 下降至约 4.35% 因降级情绪。收益率压缩支持久期资产包括成长股和债券 ETF。曲线从 2s10s 收窄陡峭化支持长期久期头寸。Fed 政策不确定性犹存；鲍威尔 6 月会议对利率路径清晰度关键。

macroRisk.en: Partial - Yield compression benefits duration assets but inflation uncertainty remains. Fed policy uncertainty with rate-cut timing unclear limits confidence.
macroRisk.zh: 部分 - 收益率压缩受益久期资产但通胀不确定犹存。Fed 政策不确定性伴随降息时机不明限制信心。

title.en: Iran Peace Deal Optimism Drives Oil Prices Down to ~$95-100
title.zh: 伊朗和平协议乐观推动油价降至约$95-100

impact.en: Brent crude retreated from $102 toward $95-100 on Iran-US peace deal optimism. Strait of Hormuz reopening eliminates war premium. Backwardation normalizing. Watch for deal finalization or breakdown triggering oil price reversal. Energy sector rotation reversing as growth resumes. $115+ requires escalated tensions. Near-term demand supports floor.
impact.zh: 布油从$102 回落至$95-100 因伊美和平协议乐观。霍尔木兹海峡 reopening 消除战争溢价。贴水正常化。关注协议最终确定或破裂触发油价逆转。能源板块轮动逆转因成长复苏。$115+ 需要升级紧张。短期需求支撑底部。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Deal breakdown risk creates oil price volatility. Stagflation toggle risk if tensions escalate. Energy sector faces price pressure but fundamentals intact.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 协议破裂风险创造油价波动。若紧张升级滞胀切换风险。能源板块面临价格压力但基本面完好。

title.en: Risk-On Sentiment Supports Tech Rally Despite Fed Uncertainty
title.zh: 风险偏好支持科技 rally 尽管 Fed 不确定

impact.en: Rate-sensitive assets rally on yield compression and de-escalation narrative. S&P 500 and Nasdaq extend gains as peace prospects improve. Market resilience near records despite Fed policy uncertainty and geopolitical fragility. Powell June meeting critical for rate cut timing clarity. Mixed event-driven environment with event-dependent outcomes.
impact.zh: 利率敏感资产收益率压缩和降级叙事 rally。标普 500 和纳指延续涨幅因和平前景改善。市场近纪录韧性尽管 Fed 政策不确定和地缘脆弱性。鲍威尔 6 月会议对降息时机清晰度关键。混合事件驱动环境伴随事件依赖结果。

macroRisk.en: Partial - De-escalation supports risk sentiment but Fed uncertainty limits upside. Rate-sensitive assets benefit from yield compression but geopolitical risks remain.
macroRisk.zh: 部分 - 降级支持风险情绪但 Fed 不确定限制上行。利率敏感资产受益于收益率压缩但地缘风险犹存。

ai.en: AI sector benefits from de-escalation sentiment with reduced risk premium. NVDA and AMD continue rally on peace deal optimism but valuation compressed by yield compression. Tech sector rotation from defensive to growth positive as energy headwinds ease.
ai.zh: AI 板块受益于降级情绪风险溢价降低。NVDA 和 AMD 继续 rally 和平协议乐观，但估值被收益率压缩。科技板块从防御性至成长轮动积极，因能源压力缓解。

semiconductor.en: Chip stocks extend gains on peace deal as energy sector rotation reverses. AI demand remains strong. But valuation compression from yield compression weighs on growth names. SMH sector mixed as rate sensitivity persists.
semiconductor.zh: 芯片股延续涨幅和平协议，能源板块轮动逆转。AI 需求强劲。但估值压缩从重成长名目。SMH 板块混合因利率敏感性持续。

bigTech.en: Big tech rallies as de-escalation narrative dominates. Rate-sensitive growth stocks benefit from yield compression. But valuation at extremes creates fragility to negative catalysts. AI momentum supports growth.
bigTech.zh: 科技巨头 rally 因降级叙事主导。利率敏感成长股受益于收益率压缩。但估值极端对负面催化剂创造脆弱性。AI 动量支持成长。

energy.en: Energy sector faces sell-off pressure as oil prices retreat from $102 to $95-100 on peace deal optimism. Supply security concerns ease. XOM and CVX under pressure from price decline but fundamentals remain solid.
energy.zh: 能源板块面临抛售压力因油价从$102 回落至$95-100 和平协议乐观。供应安全担忧缓解。XOM 和 CVX 受价格下跌压力但基本面稳固。

ev.en: EV sector benefits from de-escalation and reduced oil volatility. High fuel costs support demand fundamentals. Valuation compression from rate environment mixed. CATL concerns remain but sector rotation positive.
ev.zh: EV 板块受益于降级和油价波动降低。高燃油成本支持需求基本面。估值压缩从利率环境混合。CATL 担忧犹存但板块轮动积极。

market.en: Markets rally on de-escalation narrative. S&P 500 and Nasdaq extend gains. Sector rotation from energy to tech positive. But inflation and Fed policy uncertainty limit upside. Mixed near-term catalysts.
market.zh: 市场在降级叙事 rally。标普 500 和纳指延续涨幅。板块轮动从能源至科技积极。但通胀和 Fed 政策不确定限制上行。短期混合催化剂。

preciousMetals.en: Precious metals face headwinds from yield compression and dollar strength. Gold benefits from safe-haven demand but opportunity cost increases. Silver under pressure from rate dynamics.
preciousMetals.zh: 贵金属面临收益率压缩和美元强势压力。黄金受益于避险需求但机会成本增加。白银受利率动态压力。

oil.en: WTI crude at ~$95.50-100, Brent at ~$95-100 on peace deal optimism. Strait of Hormuz supply concerns ease. Oil market transitions from war premium to fundamentals. $100+ requires renewed tensions.
oil.zh: WTI 原油约$95.50-100，布油约$95-100 因和平协议乐观。霍尔木兹海峡供应担忧缓解。油市从战争溢价过渡至基本面。$100+ 需要重新紧张。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures up ~0.6% on de-escalation, Nasdaq 100 futures up ~0.8%, Dow Jones steady. Risk-on sentiment from peace deal optimism. Oil at $95-100 supports energy sector but growth names face valuation pressure.
futures.zh: 标普 500 期货涨约 0.6% 因降级，纳指 100 期货涨约 0.8%，道指持稳。和平协议乐观推动风险偏好。油价$95-100 支持能源板块但成长名目面临估值压力。

treasury10Y.en: 10-year Treasury yield declined from 4.45% toward 4.35% on de-escalation. Yield compression supports duration assets including growth stocks and long-duration bonds. Watch for inflation expectation shifts.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期美债收益率从 4.45% 下降至约 4.35% 因降级。收益率压缩支持久期资产包括成长股和长期债券。关注通胀预期转变。

dxy.en: DXY elevated near 105 on USD safety trade. Dollar strength from global risk flows and rate differential. JPY/USD volatility adds FX complexity. Watch for dollar rotation if de-escalation persists.
dxy.zh: DXY 在 105 附近高位因美元避险交易。美元从全球风险资金流动和其他货币利率差异增强。日元/美元波动增加货币复杂性。关注若降级持续美元轮动。

oil.en: Brent crude at ~$95-100 on Iran peace deal optimism. WTI at ~$95-100. Backwardation normalizing. Energy sector faces headwinds from price retreat but fundamentals intact. $115+ requires escalated tensions.
oil.zh: 布油约$95-100 因伊朗和平协议乐观。WTI 约$95-100。贴水正常化。能源板块面临价格回落压力但基本面完好。$115+ 需要升级紧张。

keyRisk.en: Primary risk: deal breakdown triggers oil spike to $110+. Fed policy uncertainty with rate-cut timing unclear. Geopolitical escalation creates stagflation toggle. Dollar strength creates FX headwinds. Middle East developments critical for market direction.
keyRisk.zh: 主要风险：协议破裂触发油价升至$110+。Fed 政策不确定性伴随降息时机不明。地缘升级造成滞胀切换。美元强势造成货币压力。中东发展对市场方向关键。

note.en: De-escalation narrative drives risk-on as Iran peace prospects improve, supporting broad equity rally and sector rotation from energy to tech. Oil price retreat from $102 alleviates stagflation concerns while yield compression benefits duration assets. Fed policy uncertainty and geopolitical fragility limit confidence. Market resilience near records despite uncertainty. Key risk: deal breakdown triggers violent reversal. Payrolls data adds near-term catalyst. Mixed event-driven environment with event-dependent outcomes.
note.zh: 去升级叙事推动风险偏好因伊朗和平前景改善，支撑广泛股市上涨和板块轮动从能源至科技。油价从$102 回落缓解滞胀担忧同时收益率压缩受益久期资产。Fed 政策不确定性和地缘脆弱性限制信心。市场近纪录韧性尽管不确定性。关键风险：协议破裂触发剧烈逆转。非农数据提供短期催化剂。混合事件驱动环境伴随事件依赖结果。
